svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 10/12 Goleta Pier (Common)
svg.desc: A long wooden pier past the slough. Fishing lines, pelicans, a slow walk back. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
